video_description:
E OS 3.2 has landed for the Poco X7 Pro as an advanced secured Android build, and since there are two pieces to handle — the ROM and its vendor image — here's the tidy way to get it on without a bootloop.

If you've flashed a custom ROM on this phone before, this will feel familiar: fastboot, vendor image, recovery, wipe, sideload. If it's your first time, follow the order exactly and don't rush the data wipe — it's there for a reason.

🛠️ What You Need
• The E OS 3.2 ROM file and its vendor image, both linked below.
• ADB and fastboot working on your PC.
• An unlocked bootloader.
• A backup of your data and your IMEI.

📝 Steps
1. Download the ROM and vendor files to your PC.
2. Reboot the phone into fastboot mode and connect it.
3. Flash the vendor image to both slots.
4. Reboot into recovery.
5. Factory reset / format data.
6. Sideload the ROM zip and let it finish.
7. Reboot to the system.

⚠️ Where People Get Stuck
• Flashing the vendor image to only one slot.
• Sideloading before the data wipe — that usually ends in a looped boot.
• A cheap cable that drops connection halfway through.

📝 Notes
• E OS is pitched as an advanced secured build, so keep an eye on the ROM thread for the current changelog and any known issues before flashing.
• Clean flash is the safe path — there's no reason to dirty flash here.
• Keep the vendor and ROM files from the same release; mismatched pairs cause problems.

❓ Common Questions
• Do I need both files? Yes — the ROM and the vendor image both go on.
• Can I keep my data? Do a clean flash; it's the reliable route.
• Is root included? Not by default — add it after, if you want it.
• What if it bootloops? Go back to fastboot, wipe data, and re-sideload.
